past_perfect_continuous.title: 과거완료 진행형
past_perfect_continuous.when: 과거의 다른 행동이나 시점 전에 일정 시간 동안 계속된 행동을 말할 때 씁니다.
past_perfect_continuous.body: 과거의 한 시점 전까지 이어진 과정이나 기간을 강조할 때 had been + 동사-ing를 씁니다. 완료된 결과가 더 중요하거나 know 같은 상태동사를 쓸 때는 과거완료 단순형을 씁니다: He had known her for years.
examples: They had been waiting for an hour when the bus arrived.
He was tired because he had been running.
She had been working there for five years before she moved.
mistakes: We had been wait for two hours before help came. → We had been waiting for two hours before help came. — 과거의 결과가 일어나기 전까지 계속된 행동이므로 had been waiting을 씁니다.
He had been know her for years. → He had known her for years. — know는 상태동사이므로 과거완료 단순형 had known을 씁니다.

future_perfect.title: 미래완료
future_perfect.when: 미래의 특정 시점이나 행동 전에 끝날 행동을 말할 때 씁니다.
future_perfect.body: will have + 과거분사를 씁니다. by, by the time, before와 자주 함께 씁니다: By Friday, we will have finished the project. when이나 by the time으로 시작하는 시간절에는 will이 아니라 현재 시제를 씁니다.
examples: By Friday, I will have finished the report.
She will have left by the time you arrive.
By next year, they will have built the bridge.
mistakes: By Friday, I will have finish the report. → By Friday, I will have finished the report. — 미래의 마감 시점이므로 will have completed 형태를 써야 합니다.
When he will arrive, we will have eaten. → When he arrives, we will have eaten. — when 뒤의 시간절에는 will이 아니라 현재 시제 arrives를 씁니다.

conditional3.title: 3형 및 혼합 조건문
conditional3.when: 과거가 달랐다고 가정하거나, 과거의 조건이 현재에 미치는 결과를 상상할 때 씁니다.
conditional3.body: 3형 조건문은 실제로 일어나지 않은 과거를 말할 때 If + had + 과거분사, would have + 과거분사를 씁니다(If I had studied, I would have passed). 혼합 조건문은 과거의 조건과 현재의 결과를 결합합니다(If I had taken that job, I would be rich now). 격식 있는 표현 Had I known은 If I had known이라는 뜻입니다.
examples: If I had left earlier, I wouldn't have missed the bus.
If she had studied medicine, she would be a doctor now.
Had I known, I would have helped.
mistakes: If I would have known, I would have come. → If I had known, I would have come. — if절에는 would를 쓰지 않고 had + 과거분사를 씁니다.
If he had asked me, I would help him. → If he had asked me, I would have helped him. — 결과도 과거이므로 would have + 과거분사를 씁니다.
